description.narrative: The project has three main deliverables: (i) the organising of regular consensus-building meetings for member states, including the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM), Commonwealth Foreign Affairs Ministers Meeting (CFAMM), Commonwealth Ministerial Action Group (CMAG), Commonwealth Ministerial Group on Guyana (CMGG) and Commonwealth Ministerial Committee on Belize (CMCB);???? (ii) coordinating with divisions across the Secretariat and where applicable, external partners, to ensure projects are grounded in political analysis; (iii) provision of ongoing research and monitoring to identify emerging issues and trends, leverage synergies within and across regions to support member countries in achieving developmental and other goals and providing advisory and political support to the SG and all Secretariat directorates.??
